description: Silverton Spinners auction structure with alternative slump-sale and separate asset blocks.

evidence.assertion: Notice identifies Silverton Spinners Limited and describes alternative auction blocks.
Block B-(2) includes leasehold land with a 99-year lease commencing 06-10-1994 and additional leasehold land; 1% transfer fee applies.
Option 1 is a slump sale of the entire assets; Options 2 and 3 are separate blocks, and the separate blocks are not taken up if Option 1 succeeds.
Block B-(1) plant and machinery removal is subject to a maximum four-month period; physical handover of Block B-(2) land can occur after removal when purchasers differ.
Section 29A declaration is required and EMD may be forfeited if ineligibility is found; bidders are directed to complete process documents and independent title/asset inquiries.
